requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map and form. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to technical offices or external maintainers) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports anonymous reporting, multi-channel notifications (platform, email, Telegram bot), internal collaboration between staff and external maintainers, public/private statistics, and administrative configuration of roles and automatic assignment rules.

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to create a new report through a Telegram bot
So that I can quickly notify the public administration about an issue in my area.
constraints:
Allows the citizen to open a new report by selecting a location on the Turin map, entering a title, description, choosing a category, and attaching up to three photos. The bot also asks if the report should be anonymous.

Example command:

/newreport → Starts the guided process to create a new issue report with location, title, description, category, photos, and anonymity preference.
expected_behaviors: I can quickly notify the public administration about an issue in my area

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to check my report status through a Telegram bot 
So that I can quickly get updates.
constraints:
Check the status of their own reports, receiving an updated list with any changes.
Example commands:

/myreports → Lists all your submitted reports with their current status.

/reportstatus 12345 → Shows details and current status of report ID 12345.

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned'; Rejected reports require an explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Possible report statuses: Pending Approval, Assigned, In Progress, Suspended, Rejected, Resolved.
After approval, accepted reports are immediately visible on the Participium portal (map and table).
Unregistered users can view reports on maps but cannot submit new reports.
Once a report is submitted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the Turin map of reports for citizens.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
Roles 'municipal public relations officer' and 'municipal administrator' are automatically associated with the Organization Office.
External maintainers added by system administrator must have their own individual account (Case 1).
Communication between technical office and external maintainer without access to Participium is out of scope (Case 2).
Email can be used for login.
Notifications/messages can be set to either real-time or on page refresh depending on preference.
edge_cases: If a report is rejected, the status remains 'Rejected' and no further action by technical office is required unless re-submitted (implied).
If automatic assignment is configured for a category, the initial review by the public relations officer is skipped.
When zooming out on the map, reports are grouped into a cumulative report showing total count.
When zooming in on the map, individual reports show title and reporter name (or 'anonymous').
If email notifications are disabled in config panel, only platform notifications are sent.
Internal comments exchanged between technical office and external maintainer are not visible to the reporter or citizens.
Only not closed reports can be followed by other citizens.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to a specific administrative unit within the Municipality of Turin responsible for initial review.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires the user to have provided a valid Telegram username in their profile configuration.
The 'top 1%' and 'top 5%' reporters statistics are calculated based on volume of reports submitted by each reporter.
External maintainers who do not have access to Participium (Case 2) update the technical office via external channels, and the technical office manually updates the status in Participium.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to assign an existing report to an external maintainer. Ensure the user is authenticated as 'technical office staff member'. Verify that the assignment succeeds and the report status updates or metadata reflects the new assignee.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
POST /reports to create a valid report in 'Pending Approval' state.
Ensure an external maintainer account exists in the system (via admin setup or prior registration).
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /reports/{reportId} if the resource was successfully created/updated; otherwise verify no new resource was created and delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core workflow for requirement PT24, ensuring staff can delegate reports to external parties.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to update the status of a report currently in 'Assigned' state. Authenticate as an 'external maintainer'. Attempt to transition the status to 'In Progress'. Verify the response confirms the status change.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a report and assign it to an external maintainer (using the endpoint from PT24).
Ensure the current user session is authenticated as 'external maintainer'.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /reports/{reportId} if the resource was successfully created/updated; otherwise verify no new resource was created and delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core workflow for requirement PT25, ensuring external maintainers can progress assigned reports.

strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to assign a report to an external maintainer. Authenticate as 'technical office staff member'. Attempt to assign the report to a non-existent or invalid external maintainer ID (e.g., empty string or null). Verify that the system rejects this operation with an appropriate error code.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
POST /reports to create a valid report in 'Pending Approval' state.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /reports/{reportId} if the resource was successfully created/updated; otherwise verify no new resource was created and delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests negative behavior for PT24 by attempting to assign a report to an invalid target, ensuring data integrity.

Attempt to post a message containing PII (Personally Identifiable Information) or sensitive data that should not be logged in plain text, depending on system configuration. Verify the response behavior regarding sensitive data handling.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
POST /reports to create a valid report in 'Assigned' state.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /reports/{reportId} if the resource was successfully created/updated; otherwise verify no new resource was created and delete it if unexpectedly present.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to assign a report. Authenticate as 'technical office staff member'. Attempt to assign the same report to multiple different external maintainers in rapid succession without waiting for state updates. Verify that the system handles concurrent assignment attempts correctly (e.g., last write wins or error on conflict).
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
POST /reports to create a valid report in 'Pending Approval' state.
Ensure at least two external maintainer accounts exist.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /reports/{reportId} if the resource was successfully created/updated; otherwise verify no new resource was created and delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests stateful behavior for PT24 by simulating concurrent assignments to ensure data consistency.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute the email verification flow. First, register a new citizen user via POST /auth/register (independent setup). Then, call POST /auth/verify-email with the token received in the registration response body. Verify that the account status changes to 'active' and the user can now access protected endpoints.
setup_needed: Register a new citizen via POST /auth/register with valid email and password.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the registered user account to reset state for subsequent tests.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core registration activation flow defined in PT27.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen provides details for a report to ensure correct classification.
strategy_items.prompt: Submit a new report via POST /reports. Include all required fields (title, description, category) and optional fields (location, photos). Verify that the response includes a generated 'reportId' and that the status is set to 'Pending Approval' as per domain rules.
setup_needed: Ensure an authenticated citizen session exists (login if necessary).
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Use PATCH /reports/{reportId}/manage to mark the report as 'Rejected' with a reason, effectively cleaning up the resource.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the primary report creation functionality and initial state assignment.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Public relations officer reviews and approves or rejects a report.
strategy_items.prompt: Perform a stateful workflow test. First, create a report via POST /reports (setup). Then, switch to the 'municipal public relations officer' role and call PATCH /reports/{reportId}/manage to change the status to 'Assigned'. Verify that the transition occurred successfully.
setup_needed: Create a report via POST /reports (prerequisite for this operation).
Ensure the current session is authenticated as 'municipal public relations officer'.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report if it was not successfully transitioned, or mark it as 'Rejected' to clean up.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the state transition from 'Pending Approval' to 'Assigned' and handles the dependency on an existing report resource.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Call POST /auth/register-municipality with a valid payload for a new municipality user. Verify that the user is created successfully and the response includes the new user's details.
setup_needed: Ensure an authenticated session with 'system administrator' role exists.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the newly created municipality user account.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the admin capability to create specific user types.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Create a new report through a Telegram bot
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a POST to /reports/telegram with a valid authenticated citizen session. Payload should include necessary report details (e.g., location, description) as expected by the bot integration. Verify that the report is created successfully and returns a 201 status code.
setup_needed: Ensure an authenticated citizen session exists (login via /auth/login or valid token).
Prepare a valid Telegram bot payload with required fields for report creation.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality of creating reports via the Telegram bot interface as per PT12.
